Dialogs.Dialog: ▲主人公＊▲. About what I call you...
Can I call you ▲新主人公▲？
Okay. I figured it sounds more like a couple.
(▲主人公＊▲, huh... I kind of like it.)
Hmm, I'd rather go with something else...
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, this might be good too.
I think how it is now is fine.
I'm thinking of trying ▲新主人公▲. What do you think？
(▲主人公＊▲, huh... I kind of like it.)
Hmm, I'd rather go with something else...
▲主人公＊▲. Huh, this isn't bad either.
No way. Don't push your luck.
I think how it is now is fine.
Huh？ What did you just say？
A new name for you！ ...No good？
Yay. Calling you that out of nowhere was embarrassing, you know.
(▲主人公＊▲, huh... I kind of like it.)
Hmm, I'd rather go with something else...
▲主人公＊▲. Hehe, I'll go with this.
Oh, that's... kind of a no.
I think how it is now is fine.
How does it feel to be called that？
Okay. I thought you might like this sort of thing.
(Since I've got the chance, I'll go for it...)
What's that, weird... But if that's what you want... okay.
▲主人公＊▲. Hmm, so this is what you're into.
Huh, so that's what you're into.
See, don't you want to be called like this？
(Since I've got the chance, I'll go for it...)
▲主人公＊▲. I'll call you that, as a special treat.
Oh... did you take me seriously？ I was kidding！ Hahaha！
What's that？ Aw, what a waste！
No good？ You don't like being called that？
Really？ I'm glad I worked up the nerve to say it.
(Since I've got the chance, I'll go for it...)
Geez, I'll call you that, but when you're that happy about it, it's embarrassing.
I see... Um, don't think I'm a weird girl, okay？
(Maybe I should try calling ▲小早川＊▲ something else...？)
Yeah？ Then that's what I'll call you from now on.
Yeah. Actually, I kind of like it.
Let's say no to that one.
(Maybe I should try calling ▲小早川＊▲ something else...？)
